_metadata.description: Deferred household, public-sharing, and adaptive-intelligence capabilities gated on deliberate evidence and authorization.

requirements.title: Household roles are deliberate and mapping is explicit
requirements.description: A future household capability may add deliberate roles and profile-to-person mapping with person-specific targets and shared shopping, and it should not treat multiple people as one nutritional profile; multiplying a recipe's serving count remains a distinct earlier capability.

validation.notes: Planned: two profiles in one household keep separate targets while sharing a shopping plan (spec section 19.4).

requirements.title: Public sharing handles rights before catalog
requirements.description: A future sharing or marketplace feature may proceed only with deliberate attribution, permission, redaction, moderation, and a copied-versus-linked revision policy before any public catalog exists.

validation.notes: Planned review of attribution, permission, redaction, moderation, and copied-versus-linked revision handling before enabling any public catalog (spec section 18.3).

requirements.title: Adaptive intelligence is evidence-gated
requirements.description: Adaptive or deferred intelligence such as adherence and temptation modeling, probabilistic inventory, expected-waste and effective-cost optimization, research agents, receipt or order ingestion, and automated ordering may be evaluated only with its required evidence and authorization, while transparent rules and voluntary feedback come first.

validation.notes: Planned: each deferred capability is disabled by default and exposes the inputs and evaluation criteria it requires before activation (spec section 14.7).
